ارباثثت (form XI)
# اِرْبَاثَثْتُ (irbāṯaṯtu) /ir.baː.θaθ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِرْبَاثَّ (irbāṯṯa)
# اِرْبَاثَثْتَ (irbāṯaṯta) /ir.baː.θaθ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِرْبَاثَّ (irbāṯṯa)
# اِرْبَاثَثْتِ (irbāṯaṯti) /ir.baː.θaθ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِرْبَاثَّ (irbāṯṯa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
